**Authors:** Andrew Ilyas, Shibani Santurkar, Logan Engstrom, Brandon Tran, Aleksander Madry  
**Year:** 2019  
**Journal:** NeurIPS  
**DOI:** [10.48550/arXiv.1905.02175](https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.1905.02175)

## Abstract

We argue that adversarial vulnerability is a feature of the data distribution rather than the model.
